active_family: 663a bounded-IV state-aware normalized-innovation conditional law; first backend is AR flow matching but backend changes require protocol diagnostics
normalization_policy: support-aware encoded levels; daily encoded increments; history-only fixed EWMA/RMS scale with robust floor; zero center remains the deployable incumbent. 679a/680a falsified full EWMA mean centering as too deterministic even with rollout-energy repair; next test should expose EWMA drift as conditioning information without adding it as the reconstruction center.
backend_switch_policy: Do not switch AR/one-shot, flow/diffusion/copula, or Transformer/other backbone until required audits classify the failure as backend failure rather than data framing, reconstruction, conditionality, diversity, dependency, or distribution shift.
research_axis_policy: Change one axis per iteration unless diagnostics prove coupling. Axes: data_object, temporal_factorization, backend, encoder, dependency_structure, calibration.
literature_search_policy: Search papers/official sources during diagnosis when a failure class repeats twice, a methodology/backend/encoder/temporal switch is considered, a normalization failure is not understood, local fixes are exhausted, or model limitation is about to be claimed.
current_bottleneck: 680a shows sampled-rollout energy can repair the free-running jump-shape overshoot from full EWMA centering, but not the conditional allocation and regime/coverage failures. The remaining issue is not pathwise realism alone; it is how conditioning information is injected into the law.
last_result_summary: 680a fine-tuned 679a EWMA-centered IV-only and joint38 with the all-train channel-balanced rollout-energy objective. IV-only stayed 5/11: pathwise KS improved 0.649 -> 0.418 and level KS passed 15/25, but coverage90 was 0.770, calibration error 0.104, cointegration failed, median-bias fraction 14/25 failed, and mean reversion failed. Joint38 improved 4/11 -> 5/11: pathwise KS 0.361 pass and median-bias gates passed, but coverage90 0.758, kurtosis ratio 1.352 fail, level KS 14/25 fail, and mean reversion failed. Joint panel stayed acceptable with factor delta KS mean 0.108, 11/13 factor KS pass, factor-factor corr 0.838, and IV-factor corr 0.897.
next_step_recommendation: Do not stack more objectives on full EWMA centering. Implement the cleaner separation: zero reconstruction center plus history-only EWMA drift as an optional conditioning feature, so the model can learn drift persistence instead of being forced to add local drift every sampled step.
current_best_note: 510a/392a remain the historical short-frame best learned IV laws at 8/11. Within the clean general IV/anchor/joint state-aware normalized-innovation family, 666a remains the best joint-audited checkpoint, while 674a/675a is the strongest recent IV-only candidate at 7/11 with high-sample evaluation: coverage90 0.845, level KS passed, mean reversion passed, and pathwise realism passed. A joint38 audit is required before promoting the 674a-style training recipe as the general baseline.
oracle_feasibility_note: 435a reaches 11/11 only as a validation-future oracle upper bound; it is not a deployable or learned conditional scenario generator.
